verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lacks any mention of model-based end-of-turn detection, turn-taking models, or semantic VAD alternatives; only latency tuning between 'Ultra Fast' and 'High Intelligence' model modes is documented, which does not address end-of-turn detection beyond silence-based VAD. Missing for 10: any documentation of a model-based or semantic end-of-turn detector, comparison to VAD-only timeout behavior, or configuration options for turn-taking sensitivity.
